messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: on 2026-08-01 we’re changing handling for unused promo credits and adding a small automatic first-overage forgiveness. Short bullets below.

katie: TL;DR?

sam: 1) Unused Redwood-issued promos will default to roll into an account-level "grace buffer" at month-end (can be toggled off). 2) First single overage in a 90-day window will be auto-covered up to $30 (TOF). 3) Free-tier sustained throttles remain; grace buffer can be applied automatically to cover short bursts.

billing-bot: Rollout: 2026-08-01 02:00-04:00 UTC. Flags: promo-rollover, tof-30. Docs: /billing/promo-rollover.

katie: Invoice change?

sam: New invoice lines: "Grace buffer applied" or "TOF adjustment" when used. No unit-price changes. Support playbook in #support-docs.

katie: Customers can opt out?

sam: Yes, Billing Settings -> Promo rollover toggle. We'll email customers and show a Console banner at rollout.

sam: Ping me for questions.
